instruments.name: iShares Ibovespa Index ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the Ibovespa, providing a broad reference for Brazilian listed equities. Its sector and company weights follow the index rather than an equal allocation.
instruments.detail: Returns in reais reflect Brazilian equity prices; concentration in major index constituents remains relevant.
instruments.officialName: iShares Ibovespa Fundo de Índice

instruments.name: iShares B3 Small Cap Index ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the B3 Small Cap index, providing exposure to smaller Brazilian listed companies.
instruments.detail: The portfolio differs from the Ibovespa and may be more sensitive to domestic activity, financing conditions and stock liquidity.
instruments.officialName: iShares BM&FBOVESPA Small Cap Fundo de Índice

instruments.name: It Now IDIV Index ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the B3 Dividend index, selecting exposure to companies distinguished by dividends and interest on equity.
instruments.detail: This is an equity style exposure. The index selection does not guarantee future income or protect the market value of the fund.
instruments.officialName: It Now IDIV Fundo de Índice

instruments.name: It Now IFNC Index ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the B3 Financial index, concentrating exposure in Brazilian financial-sector companies.
instruments.detail: Sector concentration makes earnings, credit conditions and financial regulation particularly relevant to its performance.
instruments.officialName: It Now IFNC Fundo de Índice

instruments.name: iShares S&P 500 International Index ETF
instruments.description: Provides S&P 500 exposure through a Brazilian-listed fund investing in an overseas index fund.
instruments.detail: The B3 quotation is in reais. Performance reflects US equity exposure and currency movements, so its BRL return should not be equated with the USD return of SPY.
instruments.officialName: iShares S&P 500 FI em Cotas de Fundo de Índice — Investimento no Exterior

instruments.name: Trend Nasdaq 100 ETF
instruments.description: Provides exposure to the Nasdaq-100 through a fund traded on B3. The index has a substantial allocation to technology and growth-oriented companies.
instruments.detail: The quotation is in reais, with exposure to both the underlying international assets and exchange-rate movements.
instruments.officialName: Trend ETF Nasdaq 100 Fundo de Índice

instruments.name: Investo Teva Treasury Selic ETF
instruments.description: Tracks a basket of Brazilian Treasury Selic securities through the Teva Tesouro Selic index.
instruments.detail: Its floating-rate exposure is intended for short-duration government-bond exposure. The exchange price can differ from net asset value, and returns are not a guaranteed fixed percentage of CDI.
instruments.officialName: Investo ETF Teva Tesouro Selic Fundo de Índice
instruments.durationNote: Interest-rate duration: close to zero because Selic-linked coupons reset daily.

instruments.name: Investo MarketVector Brazil Treasury 760 Day Target Duration ETF
instruments.trackedIndex: MarketVector Brazil Treasury 760 Day Target Duration
instruments.description: Combines Selic-linked Brazilian Treasury bonds with a position in long-dated IPCA-linked bonds. The floating-rate allocation follows short-term interest rates, while the inflation-linked allocation adds exposure to changes in real yields.
instruments.detail: The mix is rebalanced monthly to maintain a target average repricing term (PMR) of 760 days, or about 2.1 years.
instruments.officialName: Investo ETF MarketVector Brazil Treasury 760 Day Target Duration Fundo de Índice
instruments.durationNote: This target is not the portfolio's modified duration: it should not be read as a direct measure of price sensitivity. A verified current modified-duration estimate is unavailable.

instruments.name: It Now IRF-M P2 Index ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the IRF-M P2 index of Brazilian fixed-rate government bonds.
instruments.detail: Bond prices respond to changes in nominal interest rates. Holding fixed-rate bonds does not make the ETF quotation or holding-period return fixed.
instruments.officialName: It Now IRF-M P2 Fundo de Índice
instruments.durationNote: Approximate duration: 2.1 years. Rounded reading of the issuer's duration chart; it changes with yields and rebalancing.

instruments.name: It Now IRF-M P3 Index ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the IRF-M P3 index of Brazilian fixed-rate government bonds, with a minimum three-year average repricing term at rebalancing.
instruments.detail: The fund is exposed to changes in nominal interest rates. Its portfolio term is not a fixed holding period, maturity date or guaranteed return.
instruments.officialName: It Now IRF-M P3 Index ETF
instruments.durationNote: Indicative duration: around 3 years, as described by the issuer. Actual price sensitivity changes with the portfolio and yields.

instruments.name: It Now Teva Treasury Fixed Rate 5 Year ETF
instruments.description: Tracks a portfolio of Brazilian fixed-rate Treasury bonds with a longer interest-rate exposure than the shorter fixed-rate funds.
instruments.detail: The index targets a five-year average repricing term. This is not the same as price duration or a fixed maturity date; rising nominal yields can cause substantial price declines.
instruments.officialName: It Now Teva Treasury Fixed Rate 5 Year ETF
instruments.durationNote: Approximate duration: 4.4 years, reported by the index provider. The five-year repricing target is a different measure.

instruments.name: It Now IMA-B5 P2 Index ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the IMA-B5 P2 index, focusing on Brazilian inflation-linked government bonds with maturities up to five years.
instruments.detail: Inflation indexation coexists with mark-to-market exposure to real interest rates; shorter maturities reduce, but do not eliminate, that sensitivity.
instruments.officialName: It Now IMA-B5 P2 Fundo de Índice
instruments.durationNote: Approximate duration: 2.1 years. Rounded reading of the issuer's duration chart; this is not the maximum five-year bond maturity.

instruments.name: BTG Pactual IMA-B 5 P2 ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the IMA-B5 P2 index of short-dated Brazilian inflation-linked Treasury bonds.
instruments.detail: It offers the same index exposure as B5P211 through a different fund. Real-yield changes, fees and trading spreads affect the investor return.
instruments.officialName: BTG Pactual IMA-B 5 P2 ETF
instruments.durationNote: Approximate duration proxy: 2.1 years, using B5P211's published duration for the same IMA-B5 P2 exposure. This is not a directly reported PACC11 portfolio figure.

instruments.name: Investo Teva Treasury IPCA+ 0–4 Year ETF
instruments.description: Tracks Brazilian inflation-linked Treasury bonds with remaining maturities from zero to four years.
instruments.detail: Inflation-linked cash flows coexist with market-price sensitivity to real interest rates. The shorter maturity range limits, but does not eliminate, that exposure.
instruments.officialName: Investo Teva Treasury IPCA+ 0–4 Year ETF
instruments.durationNote: Approximate duration: 2.0 years, reported by the index provider. Exposure is to real interest rates.

instruments.name: It Now IMA-B Index ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the IMA-B index, covering Brazilian inflation-linked government bonds across the maturity curve.
instruments.detail: The mix of shorter and longer bonds exposes the fund to changes in real yields as well as inflation adjustments.
instruments.officialName: It Now IMA-B Fundo de Índice
instruments.durationNote: Approximate duration: 6.2 years. Rounded reading of the issuer's duration chart; exposure varies with the maturity mix and real yields.

instruments.name: BTG Pactual IMA-B ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the IMA-B index of Brazilian inflation-linked government bonds across the maturity curve.
instruments.detail: Returns reflect inflation adjustments and changes in real yields. Duration varies with the index composition, and longer bonds can drive substantial price movements.
instruments.officialName: BTG Pactual IMA-B ETF
instruments.durationNote: Approximate duration proxy: 6.2 years, using IMAB11's published duration for the same IMA-B exposure. This is not a directly reported PACG11 portfolio figure.

instruments.name: It Now IMA-B5+ Index ETF
instruments.description: Tracks the IMA-B5+ index of Brazilian inflation-linked government bonds with maturities above five years.
instruments.detail: Longer-duration exposure makes market prices particularly sensitive to changes in real interest rates, despite the inflation-linked cash flows.
instruments.officialName: It Now IMA-B5+ Fundo de Índice
instruments.durationNote: Approximate duration: 8.8 years. Rounded reading of the issuer's duration chart; exposure changes with real yields and the bond mix.

instruments.name: BTG Pactual Teva Ultra-Long IPCA Treasury CE ETF
instruments.trackedIndex: Teva Tesouro IPCA Ultra Longo Convexity Enhanced
instruments.description: Tracks an index built from the three longest-dated Brazilian inflation-linked Treasury bonds in the eligible market.
instruments.detail: The ultra-long exposure is highly sensitive to changes in real yields. Its convexity-focused methodology differs from the broader IMA-B5+ exposure and does not prevent losses when yields rise.
instruments.officialName: BTG Pactual Teva Ultra-Long IPCA Treasury CE ETF
instruments.durationNote: Approximate duration: 12.8 years, reported by the index provider. This represents substantial sensitivity to real interest rates.

instruments.name: BTG Pactual Teva DI Debentures ETF
instruments.description: Provides exposure to a rules-based portfolio of DI-linked Brazilian corporate debentures and eligible Treasury Selic securities.
instruments.detail: Performance reflects floating rates, credit spreads and issuer risk. Corporate credit exposure is different from a portfolio consisting only of Treasury securities.
instruments.officialName: BTG Pactual Teva Debêntures DI Fundo de Índice
instruments.durationNote: Reported portfolio duration: approximately 2.6 years. DI-linked coupons reset with short rates; credit-spread sensitivity remains, so this is not equivalent to a 2.6-year fixed-rate Treasury exposure.

instruments.name: Trend LBMA Gold ETF
instruments.description: Provides exposure to gold through a fund traded on B3. It represents the metal rather than a portfolio of gold-mining companies.
instruments.detail: The quotation is in reais, so returns reflect gold-price movements and exchange-rate exposure. Gold produces no corporate earnings or contractual interest.
instruments.officialName: Trend ETF LBMA Ouro Fundo de Índice

instruments.name: Hashdex Nasdaq CME Crypto Index ETF
instruments.description: Provides diversified cryptoasset exposure by following the Nasdaq CME Crypto Index through an underlying fund.
instruments.detail: Index membership and weights can change. A crypto basket remains highly volatile and its B3 trading hours differ from the continuous cryptoasset market.
instruments.officialName: Hashdex Nasdaq CME Crypto Index Fundo de Índice

instruments.name: Hashdex Nasdaq Bitcoin Reference Price ETF

instruments.officialName: Hashdex Nasdaq Bitcoin Reference Price Fundo de Índice
